statements.text: First, we need commonsense permitting reform to cut red tape and get broadband and wireless projects off the ground faster. [...] Second, we should be harnessing the power of AI to speed up deployment and strengthen our cybersecurity.
statements.context: Opening statement by Rep. Houchin at a House subcommittee hearing on AI applications in communications and technology.

statements.text: Could Federal support for AI-based project review tools actually make the deployment process faster and more predictable?
statements.context: Question posed during a Senate Commerce Subcommittee hearing on AI applications in communications and technology.

statements.text: Every parent I talk to is doing everything they can to guide their kids and protect them online, on social media, through gaming platforms, and now AI.
statements.context: Opening statement by Rep. Houchin at a congressional hearing on protecting children and teens online.

statements.text: The SAFE Bots Act ensures no AI system can impersonate a licensed professional and requires age-appropriate disclosure so kids always know that they are talking to software, not a human being.
statements.context: Opening statement and initial questioning at a U.S. House subcommittee hearing on legislative solutions to protect children and teens online.
